rows.text: creative id 49190 rejected for copyright violation on image, but we own full Getty licensing rights for this asset. I attached the proof of license. on another note our account rep hasn't replied to our request for net-30 terms
rows.label: ad_review

rows.text: Can you please add PayPal as a checkout option for native funding? My business bank continuously blocks the automated $250 micro-charges throughout the day thinking it is credit card fraud, which keeps freezing our active campaigns. Can we just be billed on a single consolidated monthly invoice instead?
rows.label: billing

rows.text: Delivery fell off 70% today and install volume is practically nonexistent compared to our baseline. We need this scaling back up before our weekend promo. On another note, your campaign management dashboard has been lagging horribly today, taking 30s to load changes.
rows.label: performance

rows.label: account_access

rows.text: You charge us 20% VAT on last invoice but our company is registered in Switzerland outside EU so we should be zero tax reverse charge. Please refund the tax amount of 184 EUR to card.
rows.label: billing

rows.text: Our daily budget is set to $100 but by 4am it had already spent $98 and stopped running for the rest of the day. Can we be billed on a smoother schedule? Also, our postback URL test failed earlier today, would appreciate someone checking that too.
rows.label: billing

rows.text: 2FA code keeps not coming to my new phone so i had to log in on my partners laptop. anyway once i finally got in i saw our whole launch push is barely moving the needle and we spent way too much for basically nothing. help?
rows.label: performance

rows.text: Is there a way to bulk edit headline variations across multiple widgets? It takes way too long manually. Also 14 out of 20 variations just got marked rejected without any policy note, why did that happen?
rows.label: ad_review

rows.text: It would be super helpful if you supported split funding rules per campaign so each regional team could pull from its own cost center automatically. Right now everything hits one master card and our EMEA team accidentally ran up $9,200 on the US entity card, so we desperately need that charge reversed and re-run on the UK corporate card ending in 4019.
rows.label: billing

rows.text: We really need proper role-based user permissions in this platform. Right now it feels like everyone I invite either has full admin power to blow through our monthly budget or cannot log in at all. I just want to give our finance clerk read-only access to download receipts and let our junior copywriter draft ads without having the ability to publish them or change CPC bids.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: Our editorial native ad got declined under the 'financial claims' rule. It's a standard b2b saas case study showing customer roi, not a get-rich-quick scheme. Can an actual human take a look at this appeal?
rows.label: ad_review

rows.text: S2S postback endpoint is returning 200 OK on our logs for the past 48 hours across three client accounts, yet zero purchase events are populating in the dashboard. Click IDs are being captured and passed back unaltered in the query string. Please verify if the server-side ingestion queue is delayed or if our event name formatting is getting rejected.
rows.label: tracking_setup

rows.label: tracking_setup

rows.label: tracking_setup

Do we need to whitelist the subdomain in the account settings or pass a specific domain parameter in the init call?
rows.label: tracking_setup

rows.text: Why are my conversions suddenly showing up duplicated? rows.label: tracking_setup

rows.text: We migrated from client-side pixel tracking to server-side postbacks this morning to cut down on ad-blocker loss, and now we are seeing a 70 percent drop in recorded conversions compared to our server logs. Is there a required deduplication ID we missed, or a specific macro we need to append to our campaign destination URLs? Also, our new junior analyst still cannot see the reporting tab even though we invited him yesterday.
rows.label: tracking_setup

rows.label: tracking_setup

rows.label: tracking_setup

rows.label: tracking_setup

rows.label: tracking_setup

rows.label: tracking_setup

rows.label: tracking_setup

We have already paid the balances so nothing needs to be reversed right now, but our accounts payable department really needs a way to combine sub-account spend onto a single consolidated monthly invoice with a custom PO number field.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: client card got hit for $480 over budget on friday cuz daily caps apparently float up to 20% and nobody caught it over the weekend. i know thats how pacing works here supposedly, still ridiculous theres no way to just lock a hard monthly ceiling on an account so finance stops yelling at me.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: I am sorry to bother you, my credit card was declined yesterday when the balance hit the automatic charge limit and all of my sponsored posts paused before I noticed. I updated the card and everything is running again, though I was wondering if you could let us pick our own charge threshold or keep a backup card on file so the ads do not suddenly stop next time.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: Until there is some mechanism to attach cost-center tags to campaigns and have them pull directly into financial exports, our month-end reporting will remain broken. Our controller flagged the April statement because all campaign spend appears as one undifferentiated lump sum on the downloadable CSV, making it impossible to allocate media costs back to individual brand budgets without manually cross-referencing campaign names.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: Two of our client accounts went into suspended status on Tuesday morning because the prepay balance ran dry overnight right in the middle of a product launch. We topped them up manually, which took four hours to clear, and honestly it is hard to scale spend here when the system cannot even send a low-balance webhook or email alert to our finance inbox before funds hit zero.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: our server to server postback has been dropping about 30% of checkout events since we switched landing page domains and debugging it is a nightmare because theres no live event tester in the dashboard. any chance youre building a real-time conversion debugger or postback log viewer so we can actually see the raw payloads you receive?
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: I tried pasting the little conversion code into my store's thank-you page twice now and my sales still show up as zero even though I know people bought from the sponsored article. I am really not technical at all and I keep breaking the checkout layout whenever I touch the HTML, so I am hoping there is some kind of simple one-click store plugin or easier way to connect sales without editing raw code.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: Is there anything on the roadmap for dynamic URL macros like headline ID and thumbnail ID? Right now our analytics tool is showing huge discrepancies in click-to-session numbers because our standard URL parameters cannot capture which exact creative variation drove the visit, and even after fixing a redirect issue on our side we still cannot tie conversions back to individual headlines.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: We noticed our reported conversions were inflated by roughly 18 percent this week because customers who bookmark or reload the order confirmation page trigger the conversion pixel multiple times. While our developers can attempt a temporary workaround on the site, the platform really needs native deduplication using a passed transaction ID parameter so duplicate fires are filtered automatically.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: browser privacy blockers are killing our pixel attribution on mobile checkout pages and half our leads close over the phone anyway,, we desperately need some way to feed closed sales back into the platform after the fact.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: 38 ads just got mass-rejected for misleading claims with zero indication of whether its the headline, the crop on the thumbnail, or one word on the landing page. we lose two days every launch playing guessing games with policy - please add inline highlighting or an automated pre-check before submission so we know what triggers the filter.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: My sponsored story finally got approved yesterday after waiting almost two days, and then I noticed a tiny spelling mistake in the subheadline, so I fixed one letter and now it is stuck waiting to be checked all over again while my weekend sale is already starting. Surely there could be a gentler way to handle minor typo edits without sending the entire campaign back to the bottom of the queue?
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: Would it be possible to add a scheduled pre-approval workflow where creatives can be checked days ahead of their live start date? Every time we launch a time-sensitive holiday promotion our ads sit in pending moderation for 24 to 36 hours and we miss the first day of traffic completely, which just happened again on our latest sale batch.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: It is becoming difficult to manage client expectations when an identical native headline and landing page gets approved on one regional account and rejected on another for vague editorial reasons. Having to open a fresh inquiry every time just to guess what changed is unsustainable, and there really needs to be some kind of transparency right inside the dashboard showing reviewer notes or past policy decisions.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: keep getting flagged for landing page mismatch because our site auto-redirects phone users to a shorter checkout page than desktop users!! why cant we just put two seperate urls on the same ad unit
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: CPA tripled over the weekend because three low-quality publisher widgets burned through 65% of our daily budget with zero conversions before anyone was online Monday morning. I already excluded those placements manually, though honestly we cannot keep babysitting accounts 24/7 - you really need automated rules that auto-block a site once it spends a set amount with zero conversions.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: I am getting lots of clicks on my articles which sounds nice at first, except almost everyone leaves my website in under two seconds and nobody has signed up for my newsletter yet. When I look at the reports, most of those quick clicks come from mobile game apps, and I have been clicking exclude one by one for an hour - is there any easier way to keep mobile app placements out of all my campaigns automatically?
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: Could you add creative-level frequency capping or an automatic creative freshness rotation rule? Right now our CTR drops off a cliff after about four days on every new campaign because the same readers keep seeing the exact same thumbnail until they ignore it, and campaign-level caps do not solve the issue when six different creatives are running together.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: Overnight traffic converts at a third of our daytime rate and drags down blended ROAS every morning, yet turning campaigns completely off at midnight kills the algorithm's learning phase - we really need a way to just dial bids down by hour of day instead of all-or-nothing scheduling.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: I set up five different article headlines to see which angle resonated best with readers, and within three hours the system pushed almost 95 percent of the clicks to just one headline that actually has the worst sign-up rate of the bunch. I am not sure if I configured something wrong, or if there is a way to force an even split for a few days so we can actually run a fair test before the system picks a favorite.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: Our finance department is looking for a dedicated invoice-only user role that cannot touch live campaigns. Every month our accounting clerk gets stuck unable to retrieve paid statements without emailing the marketing director to borrow her login and wait for a verification code, which violates our internal audit controls.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: a junior buyer accidentally paused the wrong clients top-spending campaign this morning because every single person on our team login can see and edit all 30 client accounts at once. we fixed the pause, still crazy theres no way to wall off specific client accounts to only the buyers assigned to them.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: During our quarterly security review we discovered a departed marketing contractor still had an active session in the ad dashboard because offboarding them from our corporate directory did not revoke their standalone password here. We have manually removed the user now, however our security policy requires enterprise SSO with SAML support before we can approve higher annual spend on the platform.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.text: Is there any kind of limited option where helpers can just drop images into a draft folder without touching money or live ads? I hired a freelance graphic designer to help upload better thumbnails for my sponsored posts, so I invited them to the dashboard, and then I realized they can also see my credit card details and change my daily budget which made me pretty uncomfortable.
rows.label: feature_request

rows.label: feature_request
